speaker: will_kemp
text: You never sounded so near death, and I say it kindly.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard you. Egeon is a long tale for a shut throat. I got through it at two.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: On breath and on the consonants. The vowels went elsewhere.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The vowels may follow when they like. The tale was told.

speaker: will_kemp
text: It was told. I have no quarrel with it. Go home before you invent a second performance of it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Cowley had the sense to keep still. Go home, William.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am going. The yard is done.
